thread:
Ana: quick heads-up — CI SAST is blocking several vendor infra PRs under infra/repos/vendor with noisy findings.
Sam: can you link one failing PR for repro?
Ana: PR #6124 — flagged `HardcodedCredential` coming from vendored dependency, likely FP.
Kevin: FYI scanner runners don't have KMS decrypt rights for vendor metadata, so they surface credential-like artifacts. We should grant only `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to the scanner SA.
Maria: agree, least-privilege only. Also add a Vault policy so the scanner SA can't be impersonated by humans.
Sam: snippet I used:
```
resource "google_project_iam_member" "scanner_kms_decrypt" {
  project = var.project
  role    = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
  member  = "serviceAccount:scanner@${var.project}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}
```
Kevin: don't forget to add an audit sink to retain scanner access logs to `projects/redwood-logs/sinks/scanner-audit` so suppressions have traceability.
Maria: suppression rules reminder — only Security or QA can approve; require Jira ticket, rationale, repro, and a duration TTL. Block merges when `severity >= high && introduced == true`.
Jordan: builders are blocked now — can we open a narrow CI waiver for `infra/repos/vendor/*` while infra applies RBAC changes?
Ana: plan: 1) Sam applies KMS role to scanner SA; 2) Kevin wires audit sink; 3) Maria lands suppression policy + triage checklist; 4) I create a temporary CI waiver scope-limited to vendor path. Waiver expires EOD if not replaced.
sec-bot: scan result posted for PR #6124 — `HardcodedCredential` (LOW) — flagged as potential FP. reaction :mag:
Sam: created branch `infra/kms-for-scanner` and opened PR https://git.redwood/infra/pull/121 to grant decrypter role. running plan now.
Kevin: audit-sink PR https://git.redwood/infra/pull/122 opened. requesting oncall to verify logging SLOs.
Maria: suppression policy draft at https://git.redwood/security/pull/21 — adding triage checklist, false-positive indicators, required evidence.
Jordan: note for incident response — if a later suppression hides a regression, oncall automation will open a Sev2 and tag `sec-response`. include rollback steps in playbook.
Ana: adding rollback steps and playbook link to suppression policy.
Sam: deployed KMS role; CI now re-ran, PR #6124 passed gating with suppression request open. :white_check_mark:
Ana: removing temporary waiver — reopen if flake resurfaces.
Maria: I'll follow up to run a sweep for other vendor PRs still blocked and add owners to the triage list.
sec-bot: pipeline finished, suppression recorded with Jira REDWOOD-789.
